symptom: deploy-misconfig flags several non-defect URL literals as hard-coded local URLs: (1) env-backed defaults like process.env.X ?? "http://localhost:8000" — the exact remediation the rule suggests; (2) test-tooling files (playwright.config.ts, e2e/*) where a localhost target is the point; (3) docs/snippet strings (a <pre> install block, an env-file example rendered in the UI); (4) `new URL(path, "http://x")` parse bases; (5) `http://${var}` template builders.
evidence: Scanning six real earlier repos produced 30+ deploy-misconfig hits, nearly all non-defects: entrega-clara app/web/next.config.ts `API_INTERNAL_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000"` (documented as intended design), evalforge frontend/src/lib/api.ts `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8200"`, WCP apps/*/src/config.ts zod `.default("http://localhost:8000")`, policydesk web/playwright.config.ts baseURL, agenttrace dashboard demo-scenarios.ts `new URL(path, "http://sample.local")`, aria-agent frontend setup page docs string.
root_cause: The rule flags every http(s) URL literal matching localhost/http without checking whether it is already behind an env lookup, and it scans test-tooling files it should skip.
notes: Found while scanning real repos for the case-study hunt — the scanner's own false positives are registered before fixing, per the issue-register rule.
